audit.whatIsWrong: Layers disagreed on five of seven rows (full: Ekko/Skill/Skill/Skill/Ekko/Skill/Skill; content: Orianna/Orianna/Orianna/Skill/Skill/Ekko/Orianna), and the packet flags the chart as contradicting a 47.49% win rate.
audit.why: Orianna owns 1-2 outright — Parallel Convergence is not charged and Phase Dive is not learned. Level 3 evens once the dash exists. From 4 the W stun plus Timewinder trades back, and 6 through first item is his on a nearly free all-in. Two items returns the teamfight to Shockwave.
audit.corrected: Chart settled as Orianna, Orianna, Skill, Ekko, Ekko, Ekko, Orianna — three stages each side with the decisive stretch his, matching the sub-50% rate.

audit.why: The spike text already names the right beats: W-stun setup at 3-5, the risk-free Chronobreak all-in at 6, first-item dash-stun-burst, and Orianna's two-item teamfight answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no number, and the auto-reset tell on Phase Dive was absent from the page entirely.
audit.why: Parallel Convergence (W) is 22/20/18/16/14, places at 1600 range, and only stuns if Ekko himself enters the anomaly — so leaving the circle removes the stun rather than dodging it. Phase Dive (E) is 9/8.5/8/7.5/7, only 325 range, and carries an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up is the cue to step back, not the cast. Chronobreak is 110/80/50 and heals a share of damage taken, which is what makes Grievous Wounds matter here.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rebuilt on those timers, the reset tell added, and anti-heal folded into breakdown.late.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal guidance anywhere despite Chronobreak's heal.
audit.corrected: breakdown.late now tells you to buy Grievous Wounds against the rewind heal.

edits.before: Ball on the wave, autos on his face — your passive-stacked autos win level 1 against almost every mid. Place, don't throw.

edits.before: Q-W online: the classic chunk combo. Trade it on his last-hits and keep the ball where his approach must cross it.
edits.after: Q-W online: the chunk combo. Trade it on his last-hits — Parallel Convergence is not up to punish you for it yet.

edits.after: E completes your kit; Phase Dive completes his — a 9s dash with an auto reset. Ball-on-self is what answers it.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-W every wave contact now. The Dissonance field controls every step he takes near the ball.

edits.before: Shockwave online — your lane presence doubles without casting anything. Every wave he contests is a potential flip.
edits.after: Chronobreak makes his dive nearly free: untargetable, rewound, healed. At 6 all the all-in risk belongs to you.

edits.before: Luden's spike: Q-W chunks a third of his bar. Shove, rotate, and let the ball-delivery threat run the river fights.
edits.after: First item turns dash-stun-burst into a kill on a squishy and Chronobreak pays the exit. Keep the ball on an ally.

edits.before: He dives a ball that shields, slows, and flips — keep it close, keep the wave middle, and make his dive a Shockwave donation.
edits.after: He dives, stuns, and rewinds — keep the ball close, keep the wave middle, and Shockwave the jump before Chronobreak pays for it.

edits.before: Ekko wins by landing Chronobreak, denying your pattern, and turning your every misstep into the all-in you hadn’t budgeted.
edits.after: Ekko wins by stunning you on his Parallel Convergence circle, dashing in with Phase Dive, and rewinding the risk away.

edits.before: Ball on his farm path, Q-W the last-hit contact, auto-weave once, and recall the ball — three-second trades his combo math can't answer.
edits.after: Ball on his farm path, Q-W the last-hit contact, auto-weave once, and recall the ball — short trades his 9s Phase Dive can't chase.

edits.before: Poking with the ball stranded at max range when his engage is up — an Orianna without her ball is a Doran's Ring with legs.
edits.after: Poking with the ball stranded at max range while you stand on his W circle — that stun starts every death in this lane.

edits.before: Good trade: Ball on his farm path, Q-W the last-hit contact, auto-weave once, and recall the ball — three-second trades his combo math can't answer. Bad trade: Poking with the ball stranded at max range when his engage is up — an Orianna without her ball is a Doran's Ring with legs.
edits.after: Good trade: Ball on his farm path, Q-W the last-hit contact, auto-weave once, and recall the ball — short trades his 9s Phase Dive can't chase. Bad trade: Poking with the ball stranded at max range while you stand on his W circle — that stun starts every death in this lane.

edits.before: - Ekko Chronobreak: matchup-defining — Erases your kill and bursts back — track the hologram and save final damage for after it. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Command: Protect for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Parallel Convergence (W) is 22s at rank 1, 14s maxed; it lands at 1600 range and only stuns if he steps into it, so leave the circle. - Phase Dive (E) is 9s and resets his auto — the wind-up is your cue, not the cast. - Chronobreak is 110s at rank 1, 50s maxed.

edits.before: From Luden's you run rivers: shove the wave, hover the ball at the choke, and Shockwave the first clump that contests. Protect-ball on your jungler doubles every gank.
edits.after: From Luden's you run rivers: shove, hover the ball at the choke, and Shockwave the first clump that contests. Protect-ball sends your jungler in shielded with a live R.

edits.before: You are the fight: ball on the diver, Shockwave the clump, Dissonance the retreat. Position behind your front line and let the sphere do the dying.
edits.after: You are the fight: ball on your diver, Shockwave the clump, and buy Grievous Wounds — Chronobreak heals him off the damage you just dealt.

edits.before: Carry through the ball — no champion controls teamfight space like Orianna; one Shockwave on three is a won game, and you decide when it happens.
edits.after: Carry through the ball — you pick the moment, and against Ekko that means the Shockwave that lands on his dash, not the one you threw before it.

edits.before: Ball on his farm path, Q-W the last-hit contact, auto-weave once, and recall the ball — three-second trades his combo math can't answer.
edits.after: W leaves a slow field behind it — drop it on his landing spot so the way back out is far slower than the 325-range dash in.

edits.before: Ekko whiffs Chronobreak and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Crash the wave to pin him, and ping the instant he leaves lane.

edits.before: That is Ekko’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.

edits.before: Poking with the ball stranded at max range when his engage is up — an Orianna without her ball is a Doran's Ring with legs.

edits.before: Track Ekko’s Chronobreak: Erases your kill and bursts back — track the hologram and save final damage for after it. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Track Chronobreak (R): 110s at rank 1 but only 50s maxed. It rewinds him to safety and heals him, so hold your final damage until after the hologram resolves.

edits.before: Level 3 you still out-range his melee combo setup.
edits.after: Level 3 evens out once Phase Dive is online.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 even out as his Timewinder-into-W stun comes online.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are his once Timewinder into the W stun lands.

edits.before: You control levels 1-3: Ekko's poke is clunky before his W stun is charged, so you land Command Attack pokes as he walks up and hold the wave to stop him detonating Parallel Convergence on you for a free trade.
edits.after: You control levels 1-2: Ekko's poke is clunky before his W stun is charged, so you land Command: Attack pokes as he walks up and hold the wave to stop him detonating Parallel Convergence on you for a free trade.

notes: Packet flagged the chart against a 47.49% win rate and the layers disagreed on five of seven rows. Settled chart: Orianna, Orianna, Skill, Ekko, Ekko, Ekko, Orianna. Rows 0, 1, 5 and 6 carry a full-layer side edit with no paired win[N] edit because content already held the target value; rows 2, 3 and 4 are paired. The Parallel Convergence stun condition was never stated — it only stuns if Ekko himself enters the anomaly, which changes the advice from 'dodge the stun' to 'leave the circle' — and the Phase Dive auto-reset tell was absent entirely. Both are now on the page. Anti-heal for Chronobreak added via breakdown.late.
